captions.detailed: A compact set of theatre binoculars designed with a sleek, low-profile black frame. It features two parallel cylindrical optical barrels connected by a central bridge, with blue-tinted glass lenses on both objective ends. A central rotary focus wheel is mounted on top of the bridge, and adjustable twist-up eyecups are positioned on each eyepiece.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of compact theatre binoculars in CadQuery. The design must feature two parallel cylindrical objective barrels joined by a central bridge plate, a central focus knob, and twist-up eyecups on the eyepieces. Apply a matte black material to the body and a blue glass material to the lenses.
captions.factory: The code constructs the binoculars by defining several cylindrical primitives. It creates the main left and right barrels using cylinders, adding larger concentric cylinders for the objective housings and eyepieces. The central bridge is modeled as a rectangular box that spans between the two barrels. A small, ribbed cylinder is placed on top of the bridge to represent the focusing knob, and circular faces on the barrel ends are extruded or capped with a distinct blue material to represent the lenses.
